label: Medicare Advantage Star Ratings and quality bonus

measure_weights.unit: weight in the summary/overall rating (patient experience/complaints and access were 4 through the 2025 Star Ratings)

cut_point_method.value: Non-CAHPS: hierarchical clustering with mean resampling (10 groups, leave-one-out, averaged); Tukey outer-fence outliers (3.0 x IQR) removed first (since Star Ratings issued Oct 2023); guardrail caps cut-point movement at 5 points (0-100 scales) except improvement, CAHPS and first-3-year measures. CAHPS: relative distribution and significance testing.

reward_factor.value: Historical reward factor (up to +0.4 for high mean, low variance) retained from 2027 Star Ratings; Health Equity Index reward not implemented

qbp_bonus.unit: percentage points added to the benchmark applicable percentage (doubled in qualifying counties)

rebate_percentage.unit: share of bid-below-benchmark savings returned as rebate

cfr_422_166.title: 42 CFR 422.166 Calculation of Star Ratings
cfr_422_166.applies_to: eCFR point-in-time 2026-10-01; 2026 and later Star Ratings
cfr_422_166.excerpt: Starting with the 2026 Star Ratings and subsequent Star Ratings years, patient experience and complaint measures receive a weight of 2.

tn26_weights.excerpt: Access or patient experience/complaints measure: Weight of 2
